verdicts.quote: Promotion is automatic. **Default A-2:** automatic booking, not an "offer with a claim window"

entries are served first-come-first-served by the System's own record of when the join was accepted ... ordered by a stable System-assigned tiebreak ... There is no priority, no paid priority, no reordering by staff
A member is promoted into a class that overlaps another booking: governed solely by the existing direct-booking rule (G-3); the waitlist adds no overlap rule.
verdicts.missing: Whether promotion into one class removes or otherwise resolves the member's active entry for an overlapping class; the existing overlap rule is unverified (G-3).

verdicts.quote: Effect: entry removed, positions behind close up, no penalty and no booking consequences.
verdicts.missing: How the existing no-show/late-cancellation policy applies to an automatically promoted booking (e.g. promoted close to start and unable to attend) is not decided.

verdicts.quote: the System promotes the head entry: it creates a booking for that member in the same operation that freed the seat ... Triggers that free a seat: a member cancels a booking; staff cancels a booking; capacity is raised
Channel: reuse whatever the app uses for booking confirmations today ... A failed delivery never undoes a promotion or removal ... Delivery failure is recorded (R-12) and retried
two seats freed at the same time promote the first two heads, each once; no head is promoted twice
a direct "Book" request from a person not at the head fails (class remains full) whether it arrives before, during or after the freeing operation
verdicts.missing: What happens when the head member themself submits a direct booking concurrently with their own promotion is not stated (only I-2 forbids holding both).

verdicts.quote: Booking service ↔ payments/credits (G-3, if present): authority is the payment/credit system, checked at promotion time (not cached from join time)
no maximum waitlist length ... is in the request, so none is specified. The *absence* of a cap is a decision for the user (G-6, open)
verdicts.missing: Whether a cap exists, its value, and what a member sees when the waitlist itself is full.

verdicts.quote: waitlist closes at the start instant ... (no promotion at or after start). ... default A-5: promote until the start instant.
Capacity raised by 3 with 1 queued → 1 promotion, 2 seats open. Capacity *lowered* ... → no booking is removed by the waitlist and no promotion occurs until confirmed < capacity.
Class cancelled (by staff): all entries end with reason "class cancelled"; each member notified (R-7).

remaining active entries end with reason "class started" ... ended entries and audit retention period: **unresolved** (G-11)
verdicts.missing: How long ended entries are kept and when they are purged.
